in_english.name: Sanae
in_english.long_meaning: Sanae is an Arabic name that means beauty, health, and well-being. It is a name of a noble girl in the Quran and is associated with happiness and joy in Islam. The name Sanae is derived from the Arabic root "s-n-'", which means to be beautiful or healthy. In Islamic tradition, Sanae is considered a name that brings happiness and prosperity to the bearer. It is also associated with the qualities of kindness, generosity, and compassion.
